item.heroes_endgame.space_stone.lore: Hidden by Odin, found by HYDRA, coveted by Thanos. A doorway to the other end of space.
item.heroes_endgame.space_stone.passive: In off hand: refuels a Rick's Portal Gun held in your main hand
item.heroes_endgame.space_stone.active: Use: fold space up to 24 blocks
item.heroes_endgame.mind_stone.lore: Freed from Loki's scepter. It touches every mind it is near.
item.heroes_endgame.mind_stone.passive: Held: hostile minds nearby are revealed
item.heroes_endgame.reality_stone.lore: The Aether, hidden by the Dark Elves where no light reaches.
item.heroes_endgame.power_stone.lore: The Orb from the temple on Morag. Mortals who hold it alone are consumed.
item.heroes_endgame.power_stone.passive: Held: Strength II - but it burns you unless another player is beside you or it sits in a gauntlet
item.heroes_endgame.time_stone.lore: Sealed in the Eye of Agamotto, won from Dormammu through an endless loop.
item.heroes_endgame.soul_stone.lore: Vormir's price was paid in full.
item.heroes_endgame.infinity_stone.gaunt: Socket it into an Infinity Gauntlet to unlock its true power
item.heroes_endgame.infinity_gauntlet.lo: Forged from Uru in the heart of a dying star. It hungers for six stones.
item.heroes_endgame.infinity_gauntlet.he: Gauntlet in main hand + stone in off hand, use: socket it. Sneak + use: choose a power. Use: unleash it.
item.heroes_endgame.infinity_gauntlet.em: The Gauntlet is empty. Socket an Infinity Stone first.
item.heroes_endgame.infinity_gauntlet.bu: Burnt out by the snap - it needs time to recover
item.heroes_endgame.sealed_eye_of_agamot: The Time Stone sleeps inside, sealed long ago by the Sorcerer Supreme.
Open it in the Nether to call Dormammu - and bargain.
item.heroes_endgame.watcher_log.lore: Uatu sees everything and interferes with nothing... almost. Use it to see what is hunting you.
item.heroes_endgame.viltrumite_sigil.lor: Proof that you survived your coming of age.
item.heroes_endgame.conquest_medal.lore: Taken from the Empire's most brutal veteran.
item.heroes_endgame.regent_crest.lore: The crest of the Grand Regent of the Viltrumite Empire.
item.heroes_endgame.black_order_insignia: Worn by the Children of Thanos.
item.heroes_endgame.doom_mask.lore: Doom always returns. You will see this face again.
item.heroes_endgame.doomsday_bone.lore: Torn from the creature that killed Superman.
item.heroes_endgame.master_mold_core.lor: The mind that built every Sentinel.
item.heroes_endgame.penance_chain.lore: Your sins were weighed - and paid.
item.heroes_endgame.velocity_9.lore: Zoom's speed serum. Incredible speed... at a terrible cost.

death.attack.heroes_endgame.infinity.pla: %1$s was overwhelmed by the Infinity Stones whilst fighting %2$s

%1$s was consumed by the Power Stone whilst fighting %2$s
death.attack.heroes_endgame.doom_tech: %1$s was outclassed by the technology of %2$s
death.attack.heroes_endgame.penance: %1$s felt all the pain they had caused, judged by %2$s
death.attack.heroes_endgame.penance.play: %1$s felt all the pain they had caused whilst fighting %2$s

%1$s was consumed by the Dark Dimension whilst fighting %2$s

infinity_stage.heroes_endgame.dormant: Dormant - the Mad Titan is unaware of this world
infinity_stage.heroes_endgame.herald: Act I - Loki and the Chitauri
infinity_stage.heroes_endgame.clock: Act II - the Infinity clock is ticking
infinity_stage.heroes_endgame.snapped: The Snap - half of all life is gone
status.heroes_endgame.profile: Powers: %s | FSang skill level %s | %s active powers
Tomorrow you come of age by Viltrumite reckoning. Somewhere far above, two Viltrumites are already on their way.
Two sonic booms rattle the sky. The Viltrumite Empire has come to test you.
message.heroes_endgame.conquest.omen: A Viltrumite veteran has been dispatched to bring you to heel. He is close.
message.heroes_endgame.conquest.incoming: Something hits the atmosphere like a missile. Conquest has arrived.
message.heroes_endgame.thragg.omen: The Grand Regent himself has heard your name.
message.heroes_endgame.thragg.incoming: The sky splits open. Grand Regent Thragg descends.
message.heroes_endgame.loki.incoming: A cold blue light flickers above you... something is coming through.
message.heroes_endgame.black_order.incom: Portals tear open nearby. The Children of Thanos have come for your stones.
message.heroes_endgame.thanos.incoming: The air grows heavy. The Mad Titan is coming.
message.heroes_endgame.doombots.incoming: Jet engines scream overhead. Latveria has taken an interest in you.
message.heroes_endgame.doctor_doom.incom: Victor von Doom is coming for you in person.
message.heroes_endgame.doomsday.incoming: The earth splits open. DOOMSDAY HAS RISEN.
message.heroes_endgame.zoom.incoming: A blur of black and blue lightning circles you. Zoom has found you.
message.heroes_endgame.sentinels.incomin: Thrusters roar overhead. Sentinels have been deployed to your location.
message.heroes_endgame.master_mold.incom: The ground shakes with colossal footsteps. Master Mold has come for the mutant who destroys its children.
message.heroes_endgame.ghost_rider.incom: Chains rattle in the dark and hellfire rises. The Spirit of Vengeance is here.
message.heroes_endgame.doom.impostor: You wear the mask of Doom? Doom will not let such an insult stand.
message.heroes_endgame.doom.doombots_inc: Jet engines scream overhead. Latveria has taken an interest in you.
message.heroes_endgame.doom.incoming: Doom has finished studying you. Victor von Doom is coming in person.
message.heroes_endgame.doomsday.tremor.0: The ground trembles beneath you. Something deep below is clawing upward.
message.heroes_endgame.doomsday.tremor.1: The tremors are getting stronger. Whatever is down there is almost free.
message.heroes_endgame.zoom.watching: Blue lightning flickers at the edge of your vision. Someone is watching you run.
message.heroes_endgame.sentinels.detecte: MUTANT SIGNATURE DETECTED. You have been registered by Trask Industries.
message.heroes_endgame.ghost_rider.watch: You smell brimstone on the wind. Your sins have not gone unnoticed.
message.heroes_endgame.infinity.loki_inc: Space itself folds open above you. Thanos has sent his herald for the stone you carry.
message.heroes_endgame.infinity.black_or: Portals tear open nearby. The Children of Thanos have come for your stones.
message.heroes_endgame.infinity.thanos_i: The air grows heavy. The Mad Titan is coming for you.
message.heroes_endgame.arrival.viltrumit: %s is facing the Viltrumite coming-of-age trial!
message.heroes_endgame.arrival.thragg: Grand Regent Thragg has come for %s!
message.heroes_endgame.arrival.loki: Loki and a Chitauri army descend on %s!
message.heroes_endgame.arrival.black_ord: The Black Order has come for the Infinity Stones %s carries!
message.heroes_endgame.arrival.dormammu: %s has opened a door to the Dark Dimension!
message.heroes_endgame.arrival.ghost_rid: The Spirit of Vengeance has come for %s!
message.heroes_endgame.viltrumite.failed: You were found wanting. The Empire will test you again once you have come of age once more.
message.heroes_endgame.zoom.stole_speed: Zoom stole your speed. It will take half a day to come back.
message.heroes_endgame.ghost_rider.judge: Your soul has been judged. Part of your debt is paid.
message.heroes_endgame.still_hunted: You are still being hunted. They will find you again shortly.
message.heroes_endgame.followed: Your nemesis is following you here...
message.heroes_endgame.victory.viltrumit: Victory! You survived the Viltrumite trial.
message.heroes_endgame.victory.thragg: Victory! Grand Regent Thragg has been defeated.
message.heroes_endgame.victory.black_ord: Victory! The Black Order has been defeated.
message.heroes_endgame.victory.doombots: Victory! The Doombots have been destroyed.
message.heroes_endgame.victory.doctor_do: Victory! Doctor Doom has been defeated... for now.
message.heroes_endgame.victory.doomsday: Victory! Doomsday has been put down.
message.heroes_endgame.victory.sentinels: Victory! The Sentinels have been destroyed.
message.heroes_endgame.victory.master_mo: Victory! Master Mold has been destroyed.
message.heroes_endgame.victory.ghost_rid: Victory! The Spirit of Vengeance has been driven off.
message.heroes_endgame.portal_gun_jammed: A nemesis is jamming your portal gun! There's no escaping this fight.
message.heroes_endgame.power_stone.burn: The Power Stone is burning through you! Share the load with another player or put it in a gauntlet.
message.heroes_endgame.snap.title: SNAP
message.heroes_endgame.snap.subtitle: Half of your power fades to dust
message.heroes_endgame.snap.world_subtit: Thanos has completed the Infinity Gauntlet
message.heroes_endgame.snap.announce: Thanos snapped his fingers. Half of all life in the world has turned to dust, and every hero feels the loss. Defeat Thanos - or snap with a Gauntlet of your own - to bring them back.
message.heroes_endgame.snap.reversed_by: %s snapped with the Infinity Gauntlet. Everyone is coming back.
message.heroes_endgame.snap.too_weak: Your body was never strong enough to hold the power of all six stones.
message.heroes_endgame.infinity.awakened: Somewhere beyond the stars, the Mad Titan turns his gaze toward this world. Someone has claimed the %s.
Thanos has decimated Xandar and taken the Power Stone.
Thanos has torn the Space Stone from the ruins of Asgard.
Thanos has taken the Reality Stone from Knowhere.
Thanos has returned from Vormir with the Soul Stone. He paid its price.
Thanos has taken the Time Stone.
Thanos has torn the Mind Stone free.
message.heroes_endgame.infinity.thanos_h: "Fine. I'll do it myself." Thanos is coming in person.
message.heroes_endgame.infinity.loki_def: Loki has fallen. The Mad Titan will not be pleased.
message.heroes_endgame.infinity.black_or: The Children of Thanos have been driven off.
message.heroes_endgame.infinity.thanos_d: Thanos has been defeated! The Infinity Stones belong to the heroes now.
message.heroes_endgame.infinity.stones_t: %s fell, and Thanos' forces took %s Infinity Stone(s).
message.heroes_endgame.vormir.subtitle: A soul for a soul
message.heroes_endgame.eye.taken: The Eye of Agamotto is empty. Thanos already holds the Time Stone.
message.heroes_endgame.eye.empty: The Eye of Agamotto has already given up its stone.
message.heroes_endgame.eye.wrong_place: The seal only breaks where the Dark Dimension bleeds into this world. Open it in the Nether.
message.heroes_endgame.eye.already: Dormammu is already bargaining with you.
boss.heroes_endgame.viltrumite.arrival.0: Every Viltrumite is tested when they come of age. Show us you are not weak.
boss.heroes_endgame.viltrumite.arrival.1: The Empire tolerates no weakness. If you cannot survive us, you were never Viltrumite.
boss.heroes_endgame.viltrumite.victory.0: Weak. As we suspected. The Empire purges what it does not need.
boss.heroes_endgame.viltrumite.victory.1: Your bloodline ends here. The Empire is stronger for it.
boss.heroes_endgame.viltrumite.defeat: You... are Viltrumite after all. The Empire will hear of this.
boss.heroes_endgame.viltrumite.retreat: We will find you again, child of Viltrum.
boss.heroes_endgame.conquest.arrival.0: I am Conquest. I was promised a fight - don't you dare disappoint me!
boss.heroes_endgame.conquest.arrival.1: The Empire sent me to bring you in. I hope you refuse.
boss.heroes_endgame.conquest.phase_bleed: Ha! You made me bleed! Finally, a real fight!
boss.heroes_endgame.conquest.phase_last: YES! THIS is what it means to be Viltrumite!
boss.heroes_endgame.conquest.gouge: Fighting fair is for the weak!
boss.heroes_endgame.conquest.grab_broken: Ha! You've got some fight in you!
boss.heroes_endgame.conquest.defeat: Heh... you're the real thing. Make them... remember this...
boss.heroes_endgame.conquest.victory.0: Is that it? I've had better fights with my own reflection.
boss.heroes_endgame.conquest.victory.1: Pathetic. Viltrum is better off without you.
boss.heroes_endgame.conquest.retreat: Run while you can. I'll enjoy hunting you down.
boss.heroes_endgame.thragg.arrival.0: I am Thragg, Grand Regent of the Viltrumite Empire. You have become a problem.
boss.heroes_endgame.thragg.arrival.1: I was bred to be the perfect warrior. You were bred to kneel.
boss.heroes_endgame.thragg.purge: The Empire does not fight alone. Purge this one!
boss.heroes_endgame.thragg.blitz: Enough. I will end this myself.
boss.heroes_endgame.thragg.defeat: This... changes nothing. The Empire... endures.
boss.heroes_endgame.thragg.victory.1: Another weakling purged. The Empire grows stronger.
boss.heroes_endgame.thragg.retreat: There is nowhere in the universe you can hide from the Empire.
boss.heroes_endgame.loki.arrival.0: I am Loki, of Asgard, and I am burdened with glorious purpose.
boss.heroes_endgame.loki.arrival.1: The Mad Titan wants what you found. Hand it over, and I may let you kneel.
boss.heroes_endgame.loki.illusion.0: Which one of us is real? Choose carefully.
boss.heroes_endgame.loki.victory.1: Is this not simpler? You were made to be ruled.
boss.heroes_endgame.loki.retreat: We'll meet again. I'm remarkably hard to get rid of.
boss.heroes_endgame.ebony_maw.arrival.0: Hear me and rejoice. You are about to be saved by Thanos.
boss.heroes_endgame.ebony_maw.arrival.1: You hold something that belongs to my master. Surrender it.
boss.heroes_endgame.ebony_maw.disarm: Such a primitive weapon. Allow me to relieve you of it.
boss.heroes_endgame.ebony_maw.victory.0: Rejoice. Even in death, you serve the Great Titan.
boss.heroes_endgame.ebony_maw.victory.1: Your sacrifice will be remembered. Briefly.
boss.heroes_endgame.ebony_maw.retreat: We will return for the stone.
boss.heroes_endgame.cull_obsidian.arriva: *Cull Obsidian roars and raises his hammer*
*The ground shakes as Cull Obsidian advances*
boss.heroes_endgame.cull_obsidian.defeat: *Cull Obsidian collapses with a final roar*
boss.heroes_endgame.cull_obsidian.victor: *Cull Obsidian tears the stone from your grasp*
boss.heroes_endgame.proxima_midnight.arr: He will not be stopped. Neither will I.
Surrender the stone and your death will be quick.
boss.heroes_endgame.proxima_midnight.vic: The stone is ours. Thanos will be pleased.
boss.heroes_endgame.corvus_glaive.arriva: The glaive hungers. Give us the stone.
You cannot kill what the glaive sustains.
boss.heroes_endgame.thanos.arrival.2: Dread it. Run from it. Destiny arrives all the same.
boss.heroes_endgame.thanos.phase_dread: You're strong. But I could snap my fingers, and you'd all cease to exist.
boss.heroes_endgame.thanos.phase_inevita: I ignored my destiny once. I cannot do that again.
boss.heroes_endgame.thanos.snap: Perfectly balanced. As all things should be.
boss.heroes_endgame.thanos.moon: I'll bring the heavens down upon you.
boss.heroes_endgame.thanos.defeat: A small price... to pay... for salvation...
boss.heroes_endgame.thanos.victory.0: The hardest choices require the strongest wills.
boss.heroes_endgame.thanos.victory.1: I know what it's like to lose. To feel so desperately that you're right, yet to fail nonetheless.
boss.heroes_endgame.thanos.retreat: I will find you. And when I do, the stones will be mine.
boss.heroes_endgame.dormammu.arrival: Who dares open the Eye in my realm? You have come to die.
boss.heroes_endgame.dormammu.loop_second: You will die. Over and over, forever!
boss.heroes_endgame.dormammu.loop_more: This is pointless! You will spend eternity dying!
boss.heroes_endgame.dormammu.yield: STOP! Enough! ...Take your stone and leave my dimension. Never return.
boss.heroes_endgame.dormammu.abandoned: The sorcerer has fled. The rift closes.
boss.heroes_endgame.dormammu.victory.1: Another soul for the Dark Dimension.
boss.heroes_endgame.doombot.arrival.0: THIS UNIT SPEAKS FOR DOOM. YOU WILL BE TESTED.
boss.heroes_endgame.doombot.arrival.1: DOOM HAS TAKEN AN INTEREST IN YOU. RECORDING.
boss.heroes_endgame.doom.arrival.0: Doom has studied you and found you... interesting. That will not save you.
boss.heroes_endgame.doom.arrival.1: Kneel before Doom, and perhaps Doom will let you serve.
boss.heroes_endgame.doom.studied: Your reliance on %s is predictable. Doom has prepared.
boss.heroes_endgame.doom.phase_sorcery: You have seen Doom's science. Now witness his sorcery!
boss.heroes_endgame.doom.phase_god: Doom is not a man. DOOM IS GOD!
boss.heroes_endgame.doom.emp: Your toys are useless against Doom.
boss.heroes_endgame.doom.siphon_start: Your power... Doom will take it. As Doom takes everything.
boss.heroes_endgame.doom.siphon_success: Yes... YES! Your power belongs to Doom now!
boss.heroes_endgame.doom.defeat: This is not the end. Doom always returns.
boss.heroes_endgame.doom.victory.1: Another rival proven unworthy. As it always must be.
boss.heroes_endgame.doom.retreat: Doom has other matters to attend to. We will meet again.
boss.heroes_endgame.doomsday.arrival: *A bone-shaking roar splits the air. Something has clawed its way up from deep beneath the earth.*
boss.heroes_endgame.doomsday.immune: *%s no longer has any effect on Doomsday*
boss.heroes_endgame.doomsday.resurrect: *Doomsday rises again - stronger, and immune to %s!*
boss.heroes_endgame.doomsday.defeat: *Doomsday falls... and this time, stays down.*
boss.heroes_endgame.zoom.arrival.0: I'm going to take your speed. And then I'm going to take everything.
boss.heroes_endgame.zoom.arrival.1: You're not the fastest. You never were.
boss.heroes_endgame.zoom.full_speed: I can feel it - your speed is mine now!
boss.heroes_endgame.zoom.taunt.1: Is this the best the Speed Force could do?
boss.heroes_endgame.zoom.taunt.2: Run. I want to see you try.
boss.heroes_endgame.zoom.victory.1: There can only be one fastest man alive.
boss.heroes_endgame.zoom.retreat: I'll be watching from the dark.
boss.heroes_endgame.master_mold.arrival: I AM MASTER MOLD. EVERY SENTINEL IS MY CHILD. EVERY MUTANT IS MY PREY.
Your soul is stained with innocent blood.
The Spirit of Vengeance has come for the guilty.
boss.heroes_endgame.ghost_rider.penance: Look into my eyes. Feel the pain you've caused.
boss.heroes_endgame.ghost_rider.defeat: Your penance is paid. Do not make me return.
boss.heroes_endgame.ghost_rider.retreat: I will return when the guilty walk again.
boss.heroes_endgame.stonekeeper.line1: I guide others to a treasure I cannot possess.
boss.heroes_endgame.stonekeeper.line2: What you seek lies before you - as does what you fear.
boss.heroes_endgame.stonekeeper.line3: The stone demands a sacrifice. To take it, you must lose that which you love.
boss.heroes_endgame.stonekeeper.line4: An everlasting exchange. A soul... for a soul.
boss.heroes_endgame.stonekeeper.accepted: It is done. %s was loved... and so the stone is yours.
advancements.heroes_endgame.root.title: Heroes Endgame
advancements.heroes_endgame.root.descrip: Your powers grow. So do your enemies.
Claim an Infinity Stone - and wake the Mad Titan

advancements.heroes_endgame.puny_god.des: Finish Loki off as a Hulk
advancements.heroes_endgame.nemesis.dorm: Loop Dormammu until he gives up the Time Stone
advancements.heroes_endgame.perfectly_ba: Put all six Infinity Stones into a gauntlet
advancements.heroes_endgame.nemesis.than: Should Have Gone for the Head
advancements.heroes_endgame.snap.title: Snap
advancements.heroes_endgame.snap.descrip: Snap your fingers with a complete Infinity Gauntlet
advancements.heroes_endgame.bring_them_b: Undo Thanos' snap with one of your own
advancements.heroes_endgame.nemesis.doom: Destroy the Doombots sent to test you

command.heroes_endgame.infinity.advanced: The Infinity clock will tick on the next check
